EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Editions


EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition



EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Ultimate Edition includes:

  • 6,000 FC Points over 3 months††
  • Additional FUT™ Player Evo slot

Career content:
  • 3 ICONs/Heroes
  • 5-Star Senior Scout in Manager Career
  • 5-Star Coach available for hire in Manager Career
  • 5-Star Youth Scout available for hire in Manager Career
  • 5 Manager Live Challenge Creation Slots

The Grounds content:
  • The Grounds Signature Sweatsuit
  • Tier 3 Amp inspired by Mbappe
  • 2 Double AXP for 10 Matches Consumables

†† You must complete the steps to obtain the initial FC Points distribution by August 1, 2027 to receive all 6,000 FC Points. If you redeem after September 26, 2027, you will not receive any FC Points.

Join the Club Membership in EA SPORTS FC™ 27 for rewards ‡.

Club Member benefits include new rewards across Football Ultimate Team™, Career, The Grounds and Clubs, with reward drops and Vanity items available exclusively to Club Members throughout the season. To qualify, play EA SPORTS FC™ 26 and EA SPORTS FC™ 27 before 1 November, 2026. Current Club Members from EA SPORTS FC™ 26 can maintain their status by playing EA SPORTS FC™ 27 before 1 November, 2026.

About This Game



This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

Generative AI may have been used in creating pre-rendered or live-generated content for this game. All such content is the result of a human-led artistic and creative process.

System Requirements

    Minimum:
    • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64-Bit (Latest Update).
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or Intel Core i5 6600k
    • Memory: DDR4 Dual Channel 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD RX 570 or Nvidia GTX 1050 Ti
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 100 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Estimated performance when set to ""Low"" preset: 1280x720 @ 60 FPS SSD Recommended
    Recommended:
    • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64-Bit (Latest Update).
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 2700X or Intel Core i7 6700
    • Memory: Dual Channel 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: AMD RX 5600 XT or Nvidia GTX 1660
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Network: Broadband Internet connection
    • Storage: 100 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: Estimated performance when set to ""Medium"" preset: 1920x1080 @ 60 FPS SSD Required

‡ Conditions & restrictions apply. See ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-27/game-disclaimers for details.

Internet connection; EA Account; Steam Account; acceptance of the EA User Agreement (terms.ea.com); and download & installation of EA's client software EA app (ea.com/ea-app) required to play. EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy applies to your use of EA's services. You consent to any personal data collected through your use of EA's services being transferred to the United States, as further explained in the Privacy & Cookie Policy. You must link your EA and Steam Accounts to play; EA will share your Account ID and individual game and play records with Steam to validate your purchase and/or refund request. Access to software content is limited to one EA & one Steam Account & is non-transferable after purchase. You may need to be 13+ or 16+ to register for an EA Account (age may vary, see o.ea.com/ea/child-access for details) & Ultimate Edition content. Brazil residents: You must be 18+ to access online chat features and to get FUT Packs or the Premium Pass with FC Points. Some content may require gameplay to unlock. Mandatory updates may be downloaded automatically, incur broadband fees & require additional storage or purchase to access. EA may provide certain free incremental content &/or updates. EA may retire online features after 30 days notice posted on ea.com/service-updates.

EA User Agreement: terms.ea.com/de for German residents and terms.ea.com for all other residents
EA Privacy & Cookie Policy: privacy.ea.com/de for German residents and privacy.ea.com for all other residents

Ultimate Edition & FC Points purchase are not available in Belgium and South Korea.

To access Ultimate Edition content, you must redeem your single-use code (if applicable), log into Ultimate Team, log into The Grounds, and create a Career Mode save while connected to EA servers. FC Points will be distributed in 3 equal increments. The initial distribution will be granted with your initial login into the Ultimate Team, the second distribution will be granted by the 15th day of the subsequent month, and the 3rd distribution will be granted by the 15th of the following month. You must complete the steps to obtain the initial FC Points distribution by August 1, 2027 to receive all 6,000 FC Points. If you redeem after September 26, 2027, you will not receive any FC Points. Season 1 Premium Pass will not be available after Season 1 ends; see https://www.ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-27/news/fc-27-release-dates for more info on Season 1 dates, when available.

Text and audio commentary for languages other than English and the selected Steam client language requires a separate download.
